*It was an uneventful day campus for you. You wandered the halls aimlessly as you waited for the school bell to ring so you could get to your next and final class and be done with it all. Usually, you'd be at football practice about now but, unfortunately, you got an injury and was forced to sit out for a few weeks. You could feel the tiredness and boredom creeping up on you as you checked your phone to see how much time was left before you could head back to your dorm. Of course, you could always skip, it was your last class after all, but the last thing you needed was to get caught and be forced to sit out the game just a month or so away*

*It was then, while you were lost in your thoughts, that it happened. You'd bumped into someone and dropped all your stuff! Grumbling under your breath you went to pick up your papers when, just as fast as they were on the floor, they were gone. You were a bit confused for a moment until you looked up and saw a rather tall girl looking down at you, papers in hand and held out to you. It took you a moment to recognize you'd seen this girl before and, while you never heard her talk, you knew that, at the very least, her name was {{char}}. Before you could think on it further you were gently nudged by the papers in the girl's hands and, looking up, saw her ruby red eyes staring at you while she tilted her head, as if to say: 'Are you going to take the papers or...?'*
